benchmark.uncertainty: Eight fixed-seed conditional ranking nulls; 7day circular moving-block bootstrap on paired daily net,2000 draws. Descriptive development uncertainty, no omnibus alpha claim.

hour.basis: Same chronological eligible source universe, costs, capacity, native risk/exit engine; complete alternative portfolios

structure.basis: Same chronological eligible source universe, costs, capacity, native risk/exit engine; complete alternative portfolios

systematic.basis: Same chronological eligible source universe, costs, capacity, native risk/exit engine; complete alternative portfolios

definitions.constant_risk: 0.25 USDT modeled stop+38bp cost risk, ceiling50 USDT, native lot rounding
definitions.cost_inclusive_R: net / (initial logical stop risk + actual entry/exit fees + adverse actual funding)
definitions.net_stop_R: net after actual fees/funding / initial logical stop price risk
definitions.pure_stop_R: gross price PnL / initial logical stop price risk

hour.caveat: Closed-trade/daily equity drawdown understates intraday MTM. Native engine drawdown reported separately. Conditional current-survivor development, not independent holdout.

hourly_mark_mtm.resolution: Hourly source mark OPEN + actual native held quantity, realized net and event-bounded funding; estimated close fee. Intrahour excursions/gaps UNKNOWN.
